content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need some assistance. I am trying to configure the function keys of the [product_name] operator device through a web interface, so that pressing a function key displays a specific message connected to that key. The message should remain visible until the key is released. Is this achievable? I would appreciate your guidance.

If you want to assign individual message texts to different function keys on the operator device, whether using hardware or a web-based interface, you need to restrict the key input together with the message display.
Thank you for your quick reply. I met the requirement by enabling the option for message acknowledgement.

analysis.insight_summary: A user aims to configure function keys on a [product_name] operator device via a web interface to show real-time, custom messages when keys are pressed and held. The feature where messages persist while the key is held was achieved by using a specific setting, indicating the product allows for tailored message display linked to user inputs. The dialogue highlights that configuration options exist, though guidance on initial setup could be improved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to set up the function keys on the [product_name] operator device, so that holding each key through the web interface displays and retains a dedicated message on the screen.
